meta.method_note: TODO(source): the post-Budget template (docs/BUDGET_DAY.md, 'The Budget for your household'). The Budget's rates are typed once, in content/budget/household/autumn-budget-2026.yaml (the household page's salary check reads only that file). If this seed is needed, copy it to data/seed/uk_tax_2027-28.json and give each figure the Budget changes for 2027-28 the value that file has for 2027-28 ('post', converted: a rate of 0.22 is 22, National Insurance thresholds a year), with the page in the source; leave the rest at 2026-27's values, which the freeze to April 2031 carries over. `pnpm validate` fails if a figure differs from the measures file or changes one the file does not. Then set quality to 'sourced' and replace these sources with the pages used. When GOV.UK's rates pages show 2027-28, the nightly ETL takes over (data/build/tax.json).
